row.title: OPEN-STANDARDS-1: one standards kit for JSON Schema, CloudEvents, W3C PROV; manifest structure is a schema
row.body: Four sessions from four projects opened overlapping standards PRs (#2259 doctrine schemas, #2260 registry and gate, #2273 config schemas and Backstage, #2274 this). Per COLLISION-1 this PR keeps only what none of the others adds: seed/scripts/stdkit.py (JSON Schema validation with a stdlib fallback, CloudEvents 1.0, PROV-JSON, Conventional Commits), its JS twin seed/worker/src/cloudevents.js, the instance manifest's structural rules moved into seed/schemas/instance.schema.json, and provenance exports as W3C PROV and CloudEvents. The doctrine schema catalog and Backstage descriptor come from the older PRs.
